segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report mixed results: some describe tightness, itchiness and a film-like residue after rinsing, while one with sensitive dry skin says it prevents acne without drying her out.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report good tolerance, calmed irritation and no new breakouts, though one sensitive-skin user with an existing allergic reaction says the product made it worse.
segments.oily: One reviewer notes the cleanser suits oilier skin better than dry skin, but another reviewer says it left her own skin feeling oily and hard to rinse clean.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report their skin feeling tight, itchy, dry or stripped after use, describing a lingering film despite rinsing; others, including one with dry sensitive skin, say it left skin soft and moist rather than dry.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin says the cleanser calmed a severe allergic reaction with redness and itching; another reviewer reports an existing allergic reaction got worse after use.
concerns.spots: One teen user with mild breakouts reportedly broke out far worse after use and needed a dermatologist; conversely, several reviewers say it prevented breakouts or cleared bumps on the skin.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer says the cleanser cleared bumps on her face better than anything she'd tried; another reports the product caused significant new breakouts on oily-leaning skin due to over-drying.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with dry skin suggests the product suits oilier skin better; another reviewer with unspecified skin type says it left her face very oily and hard to rinse.
